description: This file defines the CheckoutActivity class in an Android app, managing the user interface for the checkout process, including form handling, state binding, and order submission logic.

classes.name: CheckoutActivity
classes.description: Android activity for handling the checkout process, including form input, state binding, and order submission.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI bindings, and binds state observers.

methods.name: setupToolbar
methods.description: Configures the toolbar with title and navigation icon.

methods.name: setupFormListeners
methods.description: Sets up listeners for form input fields and the place order button.

methods.name: bindState
methods.description: Binds the ViewModel's state flows to UI updates, including form data, cart items, field errors, and submit status.

methods.name: setLoading
methods.description: Updates UI components to reflect loading state.

methods.name: setAllEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables all views within a view hierarchy.
